.admin-item-actions{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.admin-item-actions button{
  border:0;border-radius:9px;padding:9px 12px;font-weight:800;cursor:pointer
}
.btn-approve{background:#1f6f38;color:#fff}
.btn-reject{background:#7a2630;color:#fff}
.btn-hide{background:#6a4c20;color:#fff}
.btn-delete{background:#2b3540;color:#fff}
.badge{
  display:inline-flex;align-items:center;border-radius:999px;
  padding:4px 8px;font-size:.72rem;font-weight:800
}
.badge.pending{background:rgba(207,144,34,.15);color:#e6b95f}
.badge.approved{background:rgba(31,111,56,.18);color:#8fd3a2}
.badge.rejected{background:rgba(122,38,48,.18);color:#e28c96}

@media(max-width:820px){
  .testimonials-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
}
@media(max-width:620px){
  .testimonial-form{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .testimonial-form .full,.testimonial-actions{grid-column:1}
  .admin-login{grid-template-columns:1fr}
}


/* Aulas com apresentações do Canva */
.lessons-section{padding:64px 7%;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#08172a,#050d18);border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.06)}
.lessons-wrap{max-width:1180px;margin:auto}.lessons-head{margin-bottom:24px}.lessons-head h2{font-size:clamp(1.9rem,3vw,2.7rem);margin:6px 0}.lessons-head p{color:#aeb9c5;max-width:760px;margin:0}
.lesson-admin{display:none;margin:24px 0;padding:22px;border:1px solid #315071;border-radius:16px;background:#0a1b30}.lesson-admin h3{margin:0 0 8px}.lesson-form{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:12px}.lesson-form label{display:block;color:#cbd5df;font-size:.88rem;margin-bottom:6px}.lesson-form input,.lesson-form textarea,.lesson-form select{width:100%;padding:12px;border:1px solid #29435f;border-radius:9px;background:#061426;color:white;font:inherit}.lesson-form .wide{grid-column:1/-1}.lesson-form button{border:0;border-radius:9px;padding:12px 18px;background:#1f7a3a;color:white;font-weight:800;cursor:pointer}.lesson-help{font-size:.82rem;color:#91a0af}.lesson-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:20px}.lesson-card{border:1px solid #23405f;border-radius:15px;overflow:hidden;background:#091a2e}.lesson-cover{width:100%;height:220px;object-fit:cover;display:block;background:#10243c}.lesson-content{padding:18px}.lesson-content h3{margin:0 0 6px}.lesson-content p{color:#b7c4d3;margin:0 0 12px}.lesson-embed{width:100%;aspect-ratio:16/9;border:0;border-radius:10px;background:#020812;margin:8px 0 12px}.lesson-actions{display:flex;gap:9px;flex-wrap:wrap}.lesson-actions button{border:0;border-radius:8px;padding:9px 12px;background:#173f6b;color:white;font-weight:700;cursor:pointer}.lesson-empty{padding:22px;border:1px dashed #34506e;border-radius:12px;color:#9eacbb;text-align:center;grid-column:1/-1}
@media(max-width:760px){.lesson-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.lesson-form{grid-template-columns:1fr}.lesson-form .wide{grid-column:1}}


.grade-sections{display:grid;gap:22px;margin-top:24px}.grade-section{border:1px solid #203a5a;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(11,31,57,.72),rgba(5,16,31,.88));border-radius:14px;padding:20px}.grade-heading{display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:12px;margin:0 0 16px;padding-bottom:12px;border-bottom:1px solid #284666}.grade-heading span{font-size:23px;font-weight:900;color:#ff3440}.grade-heading small{font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#a9b5c7}.grade-section .lesson-grid{margin-top:0}

/* Ajustes de leitura e navegação em telas verticais */
@media(max-width:620px){
  .wrap{width:min(100% - 28px,560px)}
  .hero,.heroGrid{min-height:0}
  .heroGrid{padding:34px 0 20px}
  .hero h1{font-size:clamp(2.25rem,10vw,3rem);line-height:1.04}
  .hero p{font-size:1rem;line-height:1.6}
  .avatarStage{height:245px;margin-top:12px}
  .avatarStage img{max-height:235px}
  .avatarRing{width:205px;height:205px}
  .section{padding:32px 0}
  .sectionTitle h2,.about h2{font-size:1.65rem}
  .yearTabs{width:100%;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}
  .yearTabs button{padding:10px 8px}
  .yearBlock{padding:12px;border-radius:12px}
  .materials,.features,.gameGrid{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);gap:13px}
  .card{grid-template-columns:1fr;min-height:0}
  .cover{height:auto;aspect-ratio:16/9;min-height:0}
  .cardBody{padding:15px}
  .card h3{font-size:1.12rem}
  .card p{font-size:.9rem;line-height:1.5}
  .cardActions .btn{flex:1 1 auto}
  .grade-section{padding:13px}
  .grade-heading{flex-wrap:wrap;gap:5px 10px}
  .lesson-grid{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);gap:14px}
  .lesson-card{min-width:0}
  .lesson-cover{height:auto;aspect-ratio:16/9}
  .lesson-content{padding:14px}
  .lesson-embed{aspect-ratio:16/10}
  .lesson-actions{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .lesson-actions button{width:100%;min-height:44px}
  .testimonial-form,.testimonials-grid{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr)}
  .testimonials-section,.lessons-section{padding:38px 0}
  .admin-dialog{margin:0 auto}
}
@media(min-width:621px) and (max-width:900px){
  .materials,.features,.gameGrid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}
  .card{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .cover{height:190px;min-height:0}
}


.lesson-actions a{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;padding:10px 14px;border-radius:9px;background:#1f6fbb;color:#fff;text-decoration:none;font-weight:800;min-height:42px}
.lesson-actions a:hover{filter:brightness(1.12);transform:translateY(-1px)}
.lesson-cover-placeholder{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;color:#9ec7ee;background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 30%,#214d78,#10243c 70%)}
.lesson-cover-placeholder span{font-size:2.2rem}
.lesson-subject{display:inline-block;color:#8fc4f5;font-size:.72rem;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:7px}

/* Avatar circular restaurado no cabeçalho */
.brand-avatar{width:46px;height:46px;flex:0 0 46px;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;border:1px solid #dbe8ff;background:#0a1930;color:#f4f7fb;font-size:25px;box-shadow:0 0 0 4px rgba(211,32,47,.12)}

/* Remover somente a antiga galeria de materiais por ano (capas de PDFs de 2026) */
#materiais{display:none!important}
/* Recuperar a foto do avatar no cabeçalho usando a mesma imagem já exibida no perfil */
.brand-avatar{width:46px;height:46px;flex:0 0 46px;border-radius:50%;object-fit:cover;display:block;border:1px solid #dbe8ff;box-shadow:0 0 0 4px rgba(211,32,47,.12)}
</style>
<!-- Versão visual autocontida: avatar e capas incorporados no próprio HTML. -->
<script>
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',function(){
  const source=document.querySelector('.avatarStage img, .aboutAvatar');
  const target=document.querySelector('.brand-avatar');
  if(source && target){
    const avatar=document.createElement('img');
    avatar.className='brand-avatar';
    avatar.src=source.currentSrc || source.src;
    avatar.alt='Avatar de Rafael Mateus';
    target.replaceWith(avatar);
  }
});
</script>

/* Atalhos interativos da página inicial */
.feature-link{
  display:flex;
  flex-direction:column;
  align-items:flex-start;
  color:inherit;
  text-decoration:none;
  cursor:pointer;
  position:relative;
  transition:transform .2s ease,border-color .2s ease,background .2s ease,box-shadow .2s ease;
}
.feature-link:hover,.feature-link:focus-visible{
  transform:translateY(-4px);
  border-color:rgba(239,68,83,.75);
  box-shadow:0 12px 28px rgba(0,0,0,.2);
  outline:none;
}
.feature-link:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #ef4453;outline-offset:3px}
.feature-cta{display:inline-block;margin-top:12px;color:#ff5362;font-weight:800;font-size:.78rem;letter-spacing:.08em}
